query.text: 请帮我照看厨房里的孩子，有危险及时提醒。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the child in the kitchen and warn me immediately if there is any danger.

annotation.text_zh: 烤箱温度高，别把脸凑得太近，小心烫伤。
annotation.text_en: The oven is very hot, don't get your face too close or you'll get burned.
